WeVisOnePerception.description: Detection, OCR, segmentation and alpha matting with the official WeVisOne-VL model.

images.name: Images
images.tooltip: Input images. A batch is processed one image at a time.

model_name.name: Model
model_name.tooltip: Select a complete local model directory, including mask_decoder.pt. See README for downloads.

task.name: Task
task.tooltip: Choose the perception task. Task values are stable identifiers used by saved workflows.

query.name: Query
query.tooltip: One category per line, or a complete referring expression. In freeform mode, this is the raw prompt.

device.name: Device
device.tooltip: auto uses the device selected by ComfyUI; cpu forces CPU inference.

dtype.name: dtype
dtype.tooltip: Model computation precision. CPU inference uses float32.

max_pixels.name: Max image pixels
max_pixels.tooltip: Maximum image pixels used by the VLM processor. Higher values can use more VRAM.

max_new_tokens.name: Max new Tokens
max_new_tokens.tooltip: Maximum number of generated Tokens. Dense detections or OCR may need a higher limit.

decoder_batch_size.name: Decoder batch size
decoder_batch_size.tooltip: Number of object masks decoded together. Lower values reduce peak VRAM use.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.tooltip: 0 uses greedy decoding. Values above 0 enable random sampling.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed for sampling. With temperature 0, greedy decoding does not use sampling randomness.

bboxes.name: Boxes
bboxes.tooltip: Native pixel-space boxes. visual_prompt finds similar objects; box_matting mattes the supplied boxes.

0.name: Preview
0.tooltip: Visualization of predicted boxes, points, labels and masks.

1.name: Foreground MASK
1.tooltip: One merged mask per input image. White is foreground; matting preserves continuous alpha.

2.name: Boxes
2.tooltip: Native pixel-space boxes, grouped by input image.

3.name: Response
3.tooltip: Unmodified model response, one string per input image.

4.name: Result JSON
4.tooltip: Structured coordinates, counts, prompt and response, one JSON string per input image.

5.name: Instance MASKs
5.tooltip: One instance MASK batch per image. It is empty when no instance is found; see instance_count in the JSON.

WeVisOneMask2Alpha.description: Refine a coarse mask, box or point prompt into a continuous alpha matte using official Mask2Alpha.

images.name: Images
images.tooltip: Input images. A batch is processed one image at a time.

sam2_checkpoint.name: SAM2 checkpoint
sam2_checkpoint.tooltip: Official SAM2.1-B+ checkpoint. Its SHA256 is verified against the upstream value.

mode.name: Prompt mode
mode.tooltip: mask refines a coarse mask; bbox uses one box per image; point uses positive and negative clicks.

mask_threshold.name: Mask threshold
mask_threshold.tooltip: In mask mode, pixels above this threshold become foreground in the coarse prompt mask.

device.name: Device
device.tooltip: auto uses the device selected by ComfyUI; cpu forces CPU inference.

precision.name: Precision
precision.tooltip: bf16 enables BF16 autocast on CUDA; fp32 uses full precision.

mask.name: Coarse MASK
mask.tooltip: Required in mask mode. White is foreground. One mask may be shared across the image batch.

bboxes.name: Box
bboxes.tooltip: Required in bbox mode: exactly one native pixel-space box per image.

positive_coords.name: Positive points
positive_coords.tooltip: Foreground clicks in KJNodes PointsEditor format: [{"x": 100, "y": 200}]. Coordinates are input-image pixels.

negative_coords.name: Negative points
negative_coords.tooltip: Background clicks in KJNodes PointsEditor format: [{"x": 100, "y": 200}]. Coordinates are input-image pixels.

0.name: Alpha
0.tooltip: Continuous foreground alpha at the original image resolution.

1.name: Prompt MASK
1.tooltip: The binary prompt mask supplied to the refinement head.

2.name: Result JSON
2.tooltip: Prompt mode, image dimensions and timing, one JSON string per input image.

WeVisOneBoxEditor.description: Connect an image and drag to draw boxes. Drag edges to resize; press Delete to remove the selected box. Coordinates map back to the original image.

background.name: Image
background.tooltip: Image shown on the canvas. The first image is displayed for a batch.

width.name: Canvas width
width.tooltip: Canvas width managed by the native editor. Output boxes are rescaled to the original image width.

height.name: Canvas height
height.tooltip: Canvas height managed by the native editor. Output boxes are rescaled to the original image height.

editor_state.name: Boxes
editor_state.tooltip: Drag on the image to draw one or more boxes. Text, descriptions and colors are optional.

0.name: Boxes
0.tooltip: Native boxes mapped to original-image pixels. The same selection is shared across an image batch.
